section: FAQ: Does No Frizz Vanishing Oil have heat protection?
direction_paraphrase: The manufacturer separately instructs application to damp hair followed by a styler or heat protector. This establishes a retained damp styling scenario; dose, ends-specific placement and contact time are not supplied in this instruction.

scenario.restrictions: No heat-protection property is inferred from the later styler. No dose/site restrictions imported from another scenario.

effect: Supports damp leave-on role under unchanged v0.1 method. Independent lane records, packets and comparison remain unchanged; this is a separate main-session derivation.
